Every key below is a NEW checker finding judged MODEL-GAP by code reading (not a host defect). Evidence file:line is current at lane/lock-model-gaps + lock-host-fix-2.

GAP 1 - thread-start lambda also attributed to the spawner (inflated actor counts). Mis-step: actors of a make-thread lambda body include the spawning function; a 'main' actor arrives via the mux start->stop-loop failure path (mux.lisp:1792). Fix: attribute a thread lambda only to its thread actor; keep the failure-path call as its own actor only if reachable concurrently.
  R1b|fnn-bpnode-test-busy-p|*fnn-bpnode-test-busy-answers*:unlocked-write (bp-node.lisp:37-44, callback on the node-loop thread)

  R1b|fnn-extent-decoded-window-span-octet|fnn-cold-worker-span:unlocked-write (extent-decoded.lisp:48,87; also gap 7)

GAP 2 - no quiescence after thread death. Mis-step: fnn-mux-drained-p (mux.lisp:460-473) reads closed/inbox/arrived/conns/cleanup-debts/wake fds after (not (thread-alive-p)); every in-loop access of closed/inbox/arrived at the flagged lines (mux.lisp:1008, 1551, 1713) is itself inside with-mutex of the loop lock (read this lane), so the only unlocked reads are the post-death ones (caller owner.lisp:8890-8904 after modules-joined). Fix: model thread-alive-p-false / joined as a quiescence guard for reads of that thread's confined state.
  R1b|lambda@host/native/mux.lisp:fnn-mux-await#lambda1|fnn-mux-loop-arrived:unlocked-read
  R1b|fnn-mux-take-inbox|fnn-mux-loop-inbox:unlocked-read
  R1b|fnn-mux-stop-loop|fnn-mux-loop-closed:unlocked-read

GAP 3 - write before make-thread (happens-before spawn). Mis-step: no hb edge from a write that precedes the spawn to the spawned thread; prototype /tmp/lmg-hb-prototype.py clears nothing real because fnn-pull-service-start / mux/pull/web lambdas are passed as #'ref (no call edge) and mux wake write+spawn share a dolist. Fix: funcall-of-parameter / #'ref dataflow, then hb-before-spawn pruning.
  R1b|fnn-mux-start|fnn-mux-loop-wake-read:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:1771)
  R1b|fnn-mux-start|fnn-mux-loop-wake-write:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:1771)

GAP 5 - no publication row (unlocked_publication empty): set-once / owner-published / idempotent memo. Fix: add publication rows (contract) with a stated discipline, or model set-once-before-publish.
  R1b|fnn-constants|*fnn-constants*:unlocked-write (io.lisp:2022-2036, idempotent memo)

GAP 7 - exclusion by ACL2 state / custody handoff. Mis-step: guard is the ACL2 gate (fn-lgc-rotate-admitsp io.lisp:8440) or a token holder, not a mutex. Fix: a contract row naming the state-machine/custody guard.

GAP 10 - manual grab-mutex with timed condition-wait unresolved; W->W claim ignores (unless (holding-mutex-p lock) ...). Fix: resolve grab-mutex lock identity (as with-mutex) and honour the holding-mutex-p guard.

GAP R9 dead-path - R9 reports an await path in the mux loop that is not reachable as a blocking hold. Fix: reachability pruning for the observed condition-wait wrapper (lr2 'R9 mux-loop await (2)').
  R9|fnn-observed-condition-wait|mux-loop:await:sb-thread:condition-wait (2 records)

GAP inspector binding - R2 unresolved callable binding. Mis-step: control.lisp:239 funcall of a parameter (binding) from the inspect-answer path under O cannot be resolved to the registered inspector set. Fix: resolve the registered inspector binding set (funcall-of-parameter dataflow, as gap 3).
  R2|fnn-control-live-status-answer|unresolved:binding (control.lisp:239)

GAP R7 funcall-of-parameter escape - handler classifies via fn-fs-classify and calls the ESCAPE parameter (owner.lisp:1726-1736), which callers supply as the fence; the checker cannot see the funcall target. Fix: same dataflow, or per-caller escape resolution.
  R7|fnn-owner-actor-run|swallow:serious-condition:fault (owner.lisp:1726)

GAP R7 value-routed deferred rethrow - fnn-store-indeterminate is returned as :uncertain (bp-node.lisp:218-228) and rethrown as fnn-indeterminate by the caller (bp-node.lisp:339-341). Same class as LOCK-R7-PULL-WORKER-DEBT-RETHROW. Fix: recognise a returned-status sentinel later converted to a signal.
  R7|fnn-bpnode-app-result|swallow:fnn-store-indeterminate:indet

GAP R7 diagnostic-only protected form - the swallowed form is logging or tracing whose failure is stated not to alter custody (io.lisp:1101 after the debt is already pushed under the queue mutex; owner.lisp:1892 docstring). Fix: contract list of diagnostic sinks (fnn-err / fnn-owner-custody-trace) exempt from R7, or a typed diagnostic marker.
  R7|fnn-log-physical-close|swallow:ignore-errors:fault
  R7|fnn-owner-custody-trace|swallow:serious-condition:fault

2026-10-07 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-owner-output-install|fnn-owner-service-output-ledger:unlocked-read REAL: mux renderer fnn-owner-output-issue replaces the ledger under XOUTPUT while owner reader begin/prefix inspect it under O only; a reader can inspect the slot during replacement. XOUTPUT must order these reads as well as install/issue/receipt. The old set-once claim is false: issue and receipt also assign the slot. Planned change: take XOUTPUT only around the two presence observations, never across the owner action or output issue.

2026-10-07 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R7|fnn-owner-actor-run|swallow:serious-condition:fault REAL: the :result syncer starter permits ESCAPE=nil; if THUNK exits by raw-ev-fncall, the actor boundary itself raises fnn-fault after THUNK unwinds and consumes it with (when escape ...). This condition has not reached a fence. Planned change: classify/fence through fnn-owner-thread-escape when no escape callback exists; retain the existing callback path.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-bpnode-test-busy-p|*fnn-bpnode-test-busy-answers*:unlocked-write GAP: the checker invents an independent actor for a dynamically bound progress closure stored inside the session turn. The turn is called synchronously by fnn-bp-session-loop on the node command thread; *fnn-tcl-progress* is used only as a predicate or FUNCALL target and cannot escape its dynamic extent. Rule: source-verify nonescaping callable slots and dynamic callable bindings, connect their synchronous callers, and leave any escaping/unknown use as an async root. The previously suggested make-thread attribution is not this current tree's cause.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-constants|*fnn-constants*:unlocked-write GAP: an invented actor for that same BP progress closure makes the command-only constants memo appear concurrent; all actual callers are sequential command roots (the only non-main root in the census is the progress closure). Rule: the same source-verified callable ownership model, with a red fixture when a second real thread calls the memo. No idempotence exemption is needed.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-owner-claim-run-authority|*fnn-owner-retained-service*:unlocked-read GAP: the preliminary callable-ownership model also removes the fabricated BP progress actor from the authority census. Source writers/readers are command startup/teardown, with Q ordering atomic reservation; the apparent second actor is the same synchronous node-loop callback. Complete the nonescaping-callback rule and test a second real thread as the control; no publication row or unlocked-reader exemption.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-extent-decoded-window-span-octet|fnn-cold-worker-span:unlocked-write GAP: the field census merges executor transfer with the response token holder's cached span; the returned token owns the copied span until E-protected release/reassignment. The missing rule is object/token custody through those transfer points, not a per-field exemption. Still open: encode and test that custody; no code change for this key.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-extent-decoded-storage-start|fnn-cold-worker-decoded-storage:unlocked-write GAP: the census ignores per-worker construction before its executor spawn and before its insertion in the E-protected free list. The worker is published early in the custody roster, so merely ignoring every constructor write would be unsound. The missing rule must distinguish custody publication from availability to readers. Still open; no code change for this key.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-extent-executor-actual-return|fnn-cold-worker-phase:unlocked-read GAP: the cached-span read is by the returned token holder while executor phase transfers are protected by E. The missing rule must carry token ownership across physical return and revoke it at release/reassignment; no phase-name allowance. Still open; no code change for this key.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-seal-live-buffer|*fnn-staged-handle*:unlocked-write GAP: mustheld intersects unlocked command/startup paths with served callers even though the served writes and takes are inside O quanta. The missing rule is per-entry/per-phase mutex context, retaining a red case for a real live unlocked caller. Still open; no code change for this key.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-arena-release-due|*fnn-arena-release-custody*:unlocked-write GAP: the census combines O-ordered live release/reseat with startup and post-join observations. 2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R1b|fnn-mux-start|fnn-mux-loop-wake-read:unlocked-write GAP: the wake pipe is installed before this loop's actor starts, while final reads are after its death; the type-wide census loses per-loop initialization.
